docs.title: Board Member Quick Start
docs.text:
Use this page to get from the district home page to the materials for your meeting.

On a smaller screen, select ☰ Topics to open the documentation menu.

1. Sign inAccess authorized Board materials. 2. Find a meetingConfirm the correct date and group. 3. Review the agendaOpen sections and supporting items. 4. Open materialsRecognize public and private content.

docs.title: Five-minute workflow
docs.text:
1. Open the district's schoolboard.net site.
  2. Select Log in in the upper-right corner.
  3. Enter your Board Member username or email address and password.
  4. Return to Home after signing in if needed.
  5. Select the meeting under Upcoming Events or Past Events.
  6. Confirm the title, date, time, and Board or committee name.
  7. Select an agenda heading to expand it.
  8. Select a linked file or Read ... heading to open supporting material.
  9. Confirm that authorized private materials are visible.
  10. Refresh the live agenda shortly before the meeting.

Figure SB-BRD-001. District home page and meeting lists.

Use only your account

If another Board Member can see a private item that you cannot, contact the district administrator. Do not share accounts.

docs.title: Accessibility and help
docs.text: schoolboard.net pages support keyboard navigation, browser zoom, and common assistive technology.

docs.title: Keyboard controls
docs.text:
Key Action Tab Move forward through links and controls Shift+Tab Move backward Enter Open a link or activate a focused control Space Operate many buttons and agenda toggles Escape Close a supported menu or dialog Arrow keys Move through supported menus

Figure SB-BRD-021. Visible skip link during keyboard navigation.

docs.title: Browser zoom and screen readers
docs.text: Use browser zoom to enlarge text. Use page headings and descriptive link labels to move through content with a screen reader. On Windows, use the district-approved screen reader; VoiceOver is built into macOS.

docs.title: Quick troubleshooting
docs.text: Problem What to try Site does not load Confirm the district address and internet connection, then reload. Page appears outdated Refresh and reopen the meeting from Home. Private materials are missing Confirm that you are signed in, then contact the administrator. Agenda heading does not open Focus it with Tab and press Enter or Space. Search finds nothing Shorten the phrase and confirm that you are signed in. Reset message does not arrive Check spam, then ask the administrator to verify the account email.

docs.title: Request help
docs.text:
Start with the district's Board administrator or clerk. Include:

  • Meeting title and date.
  • Page address.
  • Agenda section or control label.
  • What you expected and what happened.
  • Browser and device.
  • Assistive technology, when relevant.
  • A screenshot with private information removed, when possible.

docs.title: Find a meeting
docs.text: Open meetings from the current site so you can confirm the date and use the latest published version.

docs.title: Navigate the signed-in site
docs.text:
The header provides your account controls, site search, and primary navigation.

Figure SB-BRD-007. Logged-in navigation and account controls.

docs.title: Open the correct meeting
docs.text:
1. Select Home.
  2. Look under Upcoming Events for a future meeting.
  3. Look under Past Events for an earlier meeting.
  4. Use Show more Upcoming Events or Show more Past Events when needed.
  5. Select the meeting title.
  6. Confirm the meeting date, time, and Board or committee name.

Figure SB-BRD-008. Upcoming and past meeting lists.

docs.title: Confirm the agenda
docs.text:
Check the meeting title and date before relying on the agenda or an attachment.

Figure SB-BRD-009. Accordion Agenda header.

Tip

Meeting titles can be similar. Confirm the date every time, especially when reviewing a downloaded or printed copy.

docs.title: Public and private materials
docs.text: An agenda can contain files and expandable HTML. Public items are available without sign-in; private items require an authorized account.

docs.title: Recognize the four material types
docs.text:
SB-BRD-011 callout Material type Who can see it 1 Public file Everyone 2 Private file Authorized signed-in users 3 Public expandable HTML Everyone 4 Private expandable HTML Authorized signed-in users

Figure SB-BRD-011. Consolidated view of public and private supporting materials.

docs.title: Public view
docs.text:
The signed-out view shows the public file and public expandable HTML without the private items.

Figure SB-BRD-015. Public supporting materials without sign-in.

docs.title: Open a file
docs.text:
1. Select the linked filename.
  2. Allow the browser to open or download it according to browser settings.
  3. Return to the agenda after reviewing the document.

docs.title: Open expandable HTML
docs.text:
1. Select the Read ... heading.
  2. Review the material within the agenda page.
  3. Select the heading again to close it.

Protect private material

A private label limits access on the site. Continue to follow district records, confidentiality, closed-session, disclosure, printing, and sharing requirements.

docs.title: Before the meeting
docs.text:
• [ ] Open the district site from a current bookmark or trusted link.
  • [ ] Sign in with your own Board Member account.
  • [ ] Confirm the meeting title, date, and time.
  • [ ] Review notices and attendance or accommodation information.
  • [ ] Expand and review each assigned agenda section.
  • [ ] Open public supporting materials.
  • [ ] Open authorized private materials.
  • [ ] Search for subjects requiring special attention.
  • [ ] Refresh the live agenda shortly before the meeting.

docs.title: After the meeting
docs.text:
• [ ] Sign out on a shared device.
  • [ ] Secure or destroy printed private materials according to district policy.
  • [ ] Report broken links, missing materials, or accessibility barriers.
  • [ ] Avoid redistributing saved copies when the live agenda may have changed.

docs.title: My Account
docs.text: Use My account to review your account summary, change the email address used for the account, or create a new password.

docs.title: Open My Account
docs.text:
1. Sign in to the district's schoolboard.net site.
  2. Select My account in the upper-right corner.
  3. Use View to review the account summary and current email address.
  4. Select Edit when you need to change the email address or password.

Figure SB-BRD-022. My Account overview.

docs.title: Change your email address
docs.text:
1. Select My account, then select Edit.
  2. Enter your current password.
  3. Replace the value in Email address.
  4. Leave Password and Confirm password empty when changing only the email address.
  5. Select Save.
  6. Return to View and confirm the updated address.

The email address is not displayed publicly. Keep it current because the site may use it for account contact, password recovery, and notifications you choose to receive.

docs.title: Change your password
docs.text:
1. Select My account, then select Edit.
  2. Enter your current password.
  3. Enter the new password in Password.
  4. Enter the same new password in Confirm password.
  5. Confirm that the password-strength and password-match feedback is acceptable.
  6. Select Save.
  7. Use the new password the next time you sign in.

Figure SB-BRD-023. Edit email address or password.

Current password required

Enter the current password before changing the email address or password. If you do not know it, use the password-reset process instead. Never include a real password in a screenshot, email, meeting note, or help request.

docs.title: Sign out
docs.text: Select Log out when you finish, especially on a shared device or shared browser profile. Confirm that Log in replaces the account controls before leaving the device.

docs.title: Glossary
docs.text:
Accordion Agenda A meeting page organized into headings that open and close.

Board Member An authorized user assigned to a Board group or equivalent access group.

My Account The signed-in account area used to review account information and edit the email address or password.

Expandable HTML Supporting material displayed as structured web content under a Read ... heading.

Private material Content shown only to signed-in users with the required permission.

Public material Content available without signing in.

Print Full Packet A print action that includes the agenda and packet materials available to the user.

Print Agenda Only A print action limited to the agenda page.

docs.text:

Function SB-BRD-011 coverage SB-BRD-010 Expanded agenda content SB-BRD-012 Structured agenda content SB-BRD-013 Private file at callout 2 SB-BRD-014 Private expandable HTML at callout 4

docs.title: Reviewer guidance
docs.text:
Reviewers should comment by page title and screenshot ID. Examples:

  • Sign in and accounts — step 4
  • Search and print — SB-BRD-018
  • Meeting checklist — before the meeting

Focus review on:

  1. Procedural accuracy for a Board Member account.
  2. Clear task labels and short paths to completion.
  3. Correct public/private terminology.
  4. Screenshot accuracy and callout clarity.
  5. Keyboard and accessibility guidance.

docs.title: Review an Accordion Agenda
docs.text: Accordion headings let you open only the sections you need while keeping your place in a long meeting agenda.

docs.title: Open and close sections
docs.text:
1. Select a section heading to expand it.
  2. Review the text and supporting materials inside the section.
  3. Open a nested heading when an item contains more detail.
  4. Select the heading again to collapse it.
  5. Use Expand All or Collapse All when those controls are available.

Figure SB-BRD-011. Expanded agenda section with four supporting-material callouts.

docs.title: Read the item
docs.text: Scan the section title first. Then review its lists, tables, recommended action, motion text, and supporting links. Structured HTML content can resize and reflow with browser accessibility tools.

docs.title: Keep your place
docs.text:
• Collapse a completed section before moving to the next item.
  • Use the browser Back control after opening a linked file when appropriate.
  • If a nested item appears missing, expand its parent section first.
  • If a heading does not open, focus it with Tab and press Enter or Space.

docs.title: Search and print
docs.text: Use site search for content across meetings. Use agenda search to move through matches within a meeting.

docs.title: Search the site
docs.text:
1. Enter a distinctive keyword or phrase in Search by keyword or phrase.
  2. Select Search.
  3. Open a relevant result.
  4. Confirm the meeting date.

Figure SB-BRD-016. Site search and results.

docs.title: Search within an agenda
docs.text:
1. Enter the term in the meeting search.
  2. Submit the search.
  3. Review the highlighted match.
  4. Use Previous and Next to move between matches.
  5. Select Clear Search to remove highlights.
  6. Select Return to Results to go back.

Figure SB-BRD-017. Highlighted agenda search match.

Figure SB-BRD-018. Clear Search and Return to Results.

docs.title: Print or save
docs.text:
1. Open the correct meeting.
  2. Select Print Full Packet to include available packet materials, or Print Agenda Only for the agenda page.
  3. Review the browser print preview.
  4. Confirm the meeting title, date, sections, and page sequence.
  5. Print or use the browser's save-as-PDF option when district policy permits.

Figure SB-BRD-019. Meeting print controls.

Figure SB-BRD-020. Browser print preview.

Warning

A printout or saved copy can contain private Board material. Secure or destroy it according to district policy.

docs.title: Sign in and accounts
docs.text: Sign in with your assigned account to view Board-only materials authorized for you.

docs.title: Sign in
docs.text:
1. Open the district's schoolboard.net home page.
  2. Select Log in.
  3. Enter the username or email address supplied by the district.
  4. Enter your password.
  5. Select Log in on the form.
  6. Confirm that My account and Log out are available.

Figure SB-BRD-002. Log in control.

Figure SB-BRD-003. Board Member login form.

docs.title: If sign-in fails
docs.text:
Check the username or email address, confirm that Caps Lock is off, and re-enter the password. The error message does not reveal which entry was incorrect.

Figure SB-BRD-004. Generic unsuccessful sign-in message.

docs.title: Reset a forgotten password
docs.text:
1. Select the password-reset link on the login page.
  2. Enter the requested username or email address.
  3. Submit the request.
  4. Check the email account associated with your profile.
  5. Use the newest time-limited reset link.
  6. Return to the district site and sign in.

Figure SB-BRD-005. Password reset request.

Figure SB-BRD-006. Password reset confirmation.

docs.title: Protect your account
docs.text:
• Use only your assigned account.
  • Do not forward password-reset messages or private material links.
  • Sign out before leaving a shared computer.
  • Store credentials in an approved password manager.
